summary: Situated in a well-established community for the over 55's, with easy access to Penrith town centre and the Lake District, a beautifully presented, fully residential park home providing excellent, 2 bedroomed accommodation in a stunning elevated setting overlooking the River Eamont.
description:
Offering a highly cost-effective alternative to bungalow living, this quiet development of park homes is situated in a popular location, conveniently placed for Pooley Bridge and the Lake District.

Built in 2020, the property provides well-designed and beautifully presented accommodation.

The main living space comprises an entrance hallway incorporating a dining area, leading to a fully fitted kitchen complete with integrated dishwasher, washing machine, fridge/freezer, induction hob, electric oven and microwave. Beyond is the living room, featuring a wood burning stove and twin French doors that open onto a private, raised decking patio area to the rear — perfect for relaxing or entertaining.

There are two double bedrooms, both with built-in storage. The principal bedroom benefits from a separate dressing room and an en-suite shower room. In addition, there is a high-specification bathroom, fitted with a step-up bath and wall-mounted television for added comfort.

Externally, the property is designed for low maintenance and offers ample paved driveway parking.

Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate all that this home has to offer.

Directions Leave Penrith heading south on the A6, proceed into the village of Eamont Bridge and at the Beehive Public House turn right signposted for Pooley Bridge, continue along this road for approximately 400 yards and then turn right signposted Southwaite Green Mill, follow the road down into the development and turn right into Watersedge.

Services Mains electric, LPG gas and drainage are connected but have not been tested. Private water supply. Utilities are supplied and invoiced by the site owners.

Key Information: • Non standard construction. • We understand that broadband and mobile telephone reception are available. For an indication of speeds and supply please see the OFCOM website: • There is private off road vehicle parking.

The property is leasehold with an annual ground rent and service charge of £1873.00.
